ac1.command:
cd backend
FAIL=0
for i in $(seq 1 10); do
  ENV=development DATABASE_URL=sqlite:///./test.db JWT_SECRET=t36baseline-0123456789-abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz STAFF_PIN=0000 TZ=UTC ./.venv/Scripts/python.exe -m pytest tests/test_auth.py tests/test_rate_limit_t23.py -q -p no:randomly || FAIL=1

ac1.note: 10/10 consecutive order runs green, each 29 passed (~18s each)
